description: Create a new reference paper account starting flat at USD 100. Replay is historical. Requires FXMacroData account access; owner-only. No live orders or model inference. Access: API key required, else returns subscription_required with a subscribe link.

label.description: Account/version display label, 1-80 characters; no credentials.

limits.description: Optional risk object: allocation (0,1], max_drawdown_pct 1-50, max_reference_age_days integer 1-7. Defaults: 1, 20, 4.

mode.description: forward observes new reference inputs; replay simulates saved historical inputs.

request_id.description: Idempotency ID: 32 lowercase hex characters; reuse only when retrying the same request.

run_id.description: 32 lowercase hex study ID from an owned run result.

name: research_paper_start
title: Start Paper Account
